drhp.business: Paushak's principal activity is the production of specialty chemicals using phosgene-based chemistry, manufactured at a single Indian plant supported by two offices. Because of the diverse applicability of phosgene and its derivatives, the Company supplies products into pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, performance chemicals and custom synthesis. Manufacturing of specialty chemicals and intermediates accounted for 99.63% of turnover, with exports contributing 17.54% of total turnover.

risks.note: MD&A states the Company faced demand pressure in certain products while pricing pressure persisted in several products on account of aggressive imports from China into the Indian market, and that the specialty chemicals outlook continues to be influenced by global overcapacity and pricing pressure. Management's own stated remedy - building relationships with key global players - is aimed at reducing this dependence, which marks it as structural rather than one-off.
risks.risk: Pricing pressure from aggressive Chinese imports and global overcapacity

risks.note: Geopolitical developments in West Asia drove volatility in energy, logistics and input markets, particularly crude-linked raw materials, causing a sharp increase in raw material prices in March 2026 while a corresponding increase in selling prices could not be effected - i.e. the Company could not reprice in time, a direct margin risk.
risks.risk: Raw material cost volatility with limited pass-through

risks.note: The BRSR material-issues table identifies 'Operational EHS considerations' as a Risk with negative financial implications, rationale 'Chances of leak of hazardous gas'. Mitigations cited are automated protection and detection systems, periodic mock drills and an additional water curtain system for fugitive emission. Phosgene is the Company's core chemistry, so this risk cannot be diversified away.
risks.risk: Hazardous gas leak / operational EHS exposure inherent to phosgene chemistry

risks.note: BRSR identifies 'Waste Management and Circular Economy' as a Risk with negative financial implications; the Company relies on reduced fresh-water use, recycled water, 3R plus 'Recover' from vent streams, 'Responsible Care' certification (re-certified Dec-23 to Nov-26) and IMS (QMS, EMS, OH&S) certification. Chemical-process waste and effluent handling remain a compliance and cost exposure.

BRSR identifies 'Human Resources Attrition' as a Risk - high attrition may lead to lower productivity and impact morale. The disclosed permanent-employee turnover rate has run near 17-19% for three consecutive years (16.81% in FY 2025-26), meaningful for a business dependent on technical process capability and safety discipline.

BRSR Section A reports just one manufacturing plant nationally and none internationally, with 99.63% of turnover from manufacturing of specialty chemicals and intermediates. Any disruption at that one site - a hazardous-gas incident, a shutdown or a regulatory action - would affect essentially all revenue.

The capital expenditure programme was only substantially implemented towards the close of FY 2025-26, and management says the benefits, including stabilization of operations and improvement in capacity utilisation, will accrue only progressively - so depreciation and the cost base step up (training plans were needed to make new assets operationally ready) before the volume benefit lands.
risks.risk: Execution and ramp-up risk on the newly commissioned capacity

risks.note: Exports contributed 17.54% of total turnover across 11 countries, and management flags uneven global growth, geopolitical uncertainty, and volatility in trade and logistics conditions as continuing features of the environment.
